title: Fair Machine Learning in Healthcare: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewed literature measuring disparities in diagnostic accuracy (e.g., skin lesion classification, chest X-rays) and resource allocation using fairness metrics such as Demographic Parity, Equal Opportunity, and Equalized Odds.
Surveyed studies evaluating performance differences in clinical text and imaging, measuring bias via disparate impact, counterfactual fairness, and similarity of word embeddings to gendered n-grams.

Analyzed literature identifying bias through the evaluation of non-random missing data patterns and label quality disparities in Electronic Health Records (EHRs) linked to teaching clinics versus private care.
Reviewed research measuring generalization performance drops in older populations and evaluating mitigation techniques like transfer learning on unbiased datasets.
Discussed the evaluation of missing-data bias in EHRs, where the systemic absence of this demographic data leads to inaccurate predictions and lower quality clinical decision support.
